verdict.rationale: MoQ's own docs say it can serve HLS players and supports CMAF/HLS for legacy devices, which is HLS egress of live broadcasts to a wide audience. The relay is also built for massive fan-out to subscribers. The HLS output is only stated in one-line marketing claims, with no detail on how it is configured, where it is produced, or how it behaves at scale. Missing for 10: documented HLS egress setup and configuration, any RTMP egress, and independent or hands-on corroboration of HLS output.

support.subject: As a developer, a live session can be egressed to RTMP or HLS so a large audience watches without joining the session

citations.quote: Ingest with OBS or FFmpeg; serve HLS and WebRTC players.
Supports CMAF and HLS for legacy device support.
Serve millions of concurrent viewers across the globe, including via Cloudflare.
